root.label: Sonia Dahmani sentenced for prison criticism

events.label: Sonia Dahmani sentenced for prison criticism

slots.name: sentence length
slots.sentence: In one example, prominent Tunisian lawyer and columnist Sonia Dahmani was sentenced to two years for criticising conditions in Tunisian prisons in a radio interview this May.

slots.name: number of cases
slots.sentence: She has been charged under the decree in five cases, each relating to remarks she made in media appearances, and had already been sentenced to 18 months’ imprisonment after criticising Saied’s policies in 2024.
